title: UI: light minimal theme, layout overhaul, frontend bug fixes
body:
The UI was using a dark glass-morphism theme with several frontend bugs: `updatePauseButtonUI()` crashed on every status poll (no `#btnPause` in DOM), `scanHistory.forEach` threw when the API returned no history, and log entries were rendered unsanitized (XSS).

## UI Redesign
- Full CSS replacement: dark glass → light minimal palette (`#f8fafc` base, white surfaces, `#e2e8f0` borders, professional box-shadows)
- Sticky top nav bar consolidating logo, phase badge, Scan Now, and a permanent Settings gear button (previously only reachable via setup checklist)
- New `main-body` flex layout: sticky sidebar + scrollable content beneath the topnav

## Bug Fixes
- **Null crash** — `updatePauseButtonUI()` now guards against missing `#btnPause` element
- **Null crash** — `scanHistory` access wrapped with `Array.isArray()` before `.forEach()`
- **XSS** — Added `escapeHtml()` helper; applied to all log entries and user-supplied content rendered into the DOM (including `avatar_url`)
- **Stale target** — `updateUserDisplay()` now appends the user chip to `#navRight` instead of the removed `header > div:last-child`
- **Hardcoded dark styles** — Inline `#2d2d2d` / `color: white` / `border: 1px solid #333` in modals and the secrets sidebar replaced with CSS variables
